_note: SYNTHETIC policy written for this PoC. Not taken from any real company.

clauses.title: Invoice completeness and arithmetic
clauses.text: Invoices with missing mandatory fields, invalid dates, non-numeric lines or an arithmetic error between line items, tax and declared total are held and returned to the vendor for correction.

clauses.title: Purchase order required
clauses.text: Every invoice must reference a valid purchase order and may only bill items that appear on that order. Invoices without a purchase order reference are held until the vendor supplies one.

clauses.title: Unit price tolerance
clauses.text: Invoice unit price may exceed the purchase order price by at most the price tolerance percentage. Prices above tolerance are held and the vendor must send a corrected invoice or credit note.

clauses.title: Quantity limited to goods receipt
clauses.text: Payment is limited to the quantity recorded on the goods receipt note. Quantity billed above quantity received is disputed and only the received portion is paid.

clauses.title: No goods receipt posted
clauses.text: If no goods receipt note has been posted for the order, the invoice is held until the warehouse confirms delivery.

clauses.title: Duplicate invoices
clauses.text: An invoice with the same vendor and invoice number as one already processed is a duplicate and is rejected, regardless of formatting differences in the number.

clauses.title: Vendor bank account change
clauses.text: If the bank account on the invoice differs from the vendor master record, payment is blocked and the case is escalated to finance control for call-back verification of the new bank details.

clauses.title: GST rate check
clauses.text: GST-registered vendors must charge the standard GST rate and unregistered vendors must not charge GST. A tax rate that differs from the vendor registration status is held for correction.

clauses.title: Approval limit
clauses.text: Any payable amount above the approval limit requires finance manager sign-off and is escalated even when all matching checks pass.
